welle_h1.ausgleich.titel: The ministries demand compensation for inflation
welle_h1.ausgleich.text1: {wer} reports that prices are rising faster than the budget law assumed. The same lira buy {prozent} % less. In real terms the ministries are short ₺{verlust} bn a year.
welle_h1.ausgleich.text2: The ministers want a supplementary budget. Without one, schools, hospitals and the armed forces will deliver less until the end of the year.
welle_h1.ausgleich.warum: The budget law fixes spending in lira. When inflation runs above plan, every allocation loses purchasing power and achieves less. In January the new budget year starts at the prices of that time.
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.nachtrag.label: Pass a supplementary budget
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.nachtrag.beschr: The lira allocations rise by the extra inflation until the end of the year. A supplementary budget costs double capital and some legitimacy; the shortfall is borrowed.
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.steuer.label: Fund it with higher VAT (+{punkte})
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.steuer.beschr: The same supplementary budget, plus a presidential decision raising VAT. That spares the deficit but makes shopping dearer.
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.hinnehmen.label: Accept the cut
welle_h1.ausgleich.opt.hinnehmen.beschr: No supplementary budget. The ministries make do with less until January, and their heads hold it against you.
welle_h1.ausgleich.bedingung.defizit: Extra spending ₺{mrd} bn a year, deficit {vorher} → {nachher} % of GDP.
welle_h1.ausgleich.bedingung.steuer: VAT {vorher} → {nachher} %. Once the rate takes effect it covers about {mehr} % of the supplement.
welle_h1.ausgleich.keineSteuer: VAT cannot be raised by decision at the moment.
welle_h1.ausgleich.unnoetig: Spending has not lost purchasing power, so no compensation is needed.
welle_h1.ausgleich.beschluss: Supplementary budget: inflation compensation for the ministries, ₺{mrd} bn a year
welle_h1.ausgleich.hingenommen: The ministries carry on with a real cut of ₺{mrd} bn a year.
welle_h1.ausgleich.hingenommenWarum: No supplementary budget. Ministers with their own budget lose loyalty. Until January their allocations only work with the purchasing power that is left.
welle_h1.oktober.mehr: This year the economy brings the budget ₺{mrd} bn more than planned. In the draft you can put the money into ministries, cut taxes by law, or use it to borrow less.
welle_h1.oktober.loch: This year the economy tears a hole of ₺{mrd} bn in revenue. In the draft you can cut ministries, raise taxes by law, or borrow to cover the hole.
welle_h1.oktober.planmaessig: Revenue is on plan this year.
welle_h1.vollzug.ausgaben: Spending excluding interest is fixed by the budget law: ₺{bio} tn a year. Revenue follows the economy.
welle_h1.vollzug.kaufkraftMinus: Because prices rose faster than planned, the same lira buy {prozent} % less, ₺{mrd} bn in real terms.
welle_h1.vollzug.kaufkraftPlus: Because prices rose more slowly than planned, the same lira buy {prozent} % more, ₺{mrd} bn in real terms.
welle_h1.treiber.uebergang: Older saves: the former cyclical balance runs out in twelve monthly steps so the deficit does not jump on loading.
welle_h1.treiber.wirtschaft: Spending is fixed in lira, revenue follows GDP. When the economy runs above plan the deficit falls; below plan it rises. In January the new budget plans with the GDP of that time.
